question: Name India's lone participant in the winter Olympics, who finished 45th in the giant slalom event.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arif Khan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India's lone participant** in the winter Olympics, who finished 45th in the giant slalom event is **Arif Khan**.
 
• He took home** two gold medals** from the **South Asian Winter Games in 2011 **in the Alpine skiing events of slalom and giant slalom.
 
• In the slalom and giant slalom competitions in the** 2022 Winter Olympics**, he competed on behalf of India.
 
• He placed 45th in the giant slalom competition and will compete in the slalom on the** 16th.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Himanshu Thakur** is an** Indian alpine skier**.

 
 
• In the giant slalom competition, he represented India at the **2014 Winter Olympics, **placing **72nd** overall.
 
• In February** 2017**, Thakur was selected for India's squad for the **2017 Asian Winter Games.**
 
 
 
• **Aanchal Thakur** is the first Indian to win an **international medal** in skiing. 
 
 
• She won a **bronze medal **in the **Alpine Ejder 3200 Cup **held in **Turkey** in January 2018.
